errors.evidence: In the sentence 'Стълбовете за периодите 1996-2001 и 2008-2012 достигат съответно приблизително 15% и 20%', the value for the period 1996-2001 is stated as approximately 15%. However, the bar in the chart for this period clearly reaches approximately 18%.
